Subject: Shared benchmarking note
Date: Thursday 5 November 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Imogen Fairlie <imogen.fairlie@wyndhamretail.example.test>, Jack Merrow <jack.merrow@bramleyfoods.example.test>

Imogen, Jack,

Both of you asked for the same thing, so here is one note covering it.

Imogen, I will send you the Wyndham specific figures by 12 November. Jack, I will send you the Bramley comparison by 13 November.

Neither set identifies the other, so there is nothing to worry about on confidentiality.

Best,
Dom
